messages:
Alex (Eng): Hey team — planning a 6-week remote work block from Portugal (June 15 / July 27). Staying on US payroll. Quick Qs: do I still get the WFH stipend while abroad? Also, can I ship my standing desk and dual monitor? Any customs or cap concerns?

Bea (People Ops): Short answer: yes, stipend prorated for temporary remote. Shipping can be reimbursed but needs pre-approval for > $500. Please fill the temp-remote form and attach shipper quote + manager sign-off.

Alex (Eng): Cool. Where's the form? And how do you pro-rate the stipend (daily or monthly)?

PeopleOps Bot: Temp remote form: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/temp-remote-form. Policy: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/policies/temp-remote. Automation: >=90d triggers payroll/localization workflow.

Bea (People Ops): We prorate by days in each month at the monthly stipend rate (examples on the form). If homebase stays US we pay USD. Attach quotes for shipping; People Ops can pre-approve up to $600 for combined desk+monitor shipping. Above that needs Finance review.

Alex (Eng): Got it. Any legal flags I should watch for? I won't be meeting customers.

Mateo (Legal): For 6 weeks corporate nexus/PE risk is low for one headcount, especially with no customer-facing work. Primary risk is personal tax residency (183-day rule). Well do a quick jurisdiction check on form submission. Please mark as "short-term EU".

Kiran (Payroll): FYI: if Legal recommends localization we may need to move payroll — that can delay stipend timing. Keep your W-9/W-8 info up to date.

Alex (Eng): Thanks — filing now and will attach FedEx quotes + manager sign-off. Will tag when submitted.

Bea (People Ops): Thanks! Once submitted well review within 48 business hours and reply with shipping pre-approval status. :sparkles:

PeopleOps Bot: Form received: TR-2026-3301. Status: pending manager sign-off -> People Ops review -> Legal/Payroll as needed. ETA: 48-72 hrs.
